chunks: And on the Day when He calls them and says: 'What answer did you give the apostles?'
ai.seo_question: What question will God ask disbelievers on the Day of Judgment regarding the messengers?
ai.summary: In Surah Az-Zukhruf, this verse underscores the ultimate accountability of humanity for their reception of the Prophets, a central theme in Shia exegesis regarding the clarity of divine guidance. It serves as a direct challenge to those who rejected the messengers, emphasizing that their excuse of ignorance will be invalid on the Day of Resurrection.
